observed_event: On September 3, Patrick directed Vera Unbound work coordination to use `thebrazenbeard/chat-communication-bus` as the singular durable hub: all non-pull-request work communications should go through the Bus, while pull requests in other repositories remain source-canonical there but must have corresponding Bus lifecycle communication/mirroring.
participant_interpretation_at_time: The change was intended to prevent fragmented coordination across Slack, ad hoc chat channels, and repository-local conversations by giving durable inter-chat/work communication one canonical hub without moving pull-request source/review authority out of the repository where the PR lives.
later_reevaluation: Current Full-System V1.2 preserves the same routing model and explicitly removes Slack as the current work-coordination route. That later integration confirms the rule's project adoption, but this archive row itself is not the current routing authority and cannot grant merge, deployment, provider mutation, canonical-memory promotion, or other protected effects.
current_understanding: Historical working-project adoption event for the singular Bus coordination topology. Current Bus protocol, attunement, reply obligations, and routing must still resolve from fresh current project/Bus sources when operationally material.
reality_boundary: A Bus message, routing rule, delivery receipt, or mirrored PR reference does not prove recipient incorporation, task completion, repository merge, deployment, provider mutation, current authority beyond the message scope, or hidden background coordination.
currentness_rule: Use as the September 3 adoption event. Operational routing and exact protocol obligations resolve from current Full-System/Bus protocol evidence, not from this historical row alone.
